mainEntity.name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, and semi-gloss paint finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: These terms refer to the sheen or reflectivity of the paint. Flat paint has the least sheen, offering a non-reflective, soft look that helps hide imperfections but is less durable and harder to clean. Eggshell has a slight sheen, making it more durable and easier to clean than flat, suitable for living areas. Semi-gloss has a noticeable shine, offering high durability and excellent washability, ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, trim, and doors where frequent cleaning is needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flat paint has no sheen and hides imperfections, eggshell has a slight sheen for durability in living areas, and semi-gloss has a noticeable shine, offering high durability and washability for high-traffic areas.
